name: Theme settings
summary: A Theme button that opens a popover with a colour mode, a theme grid with Random, and the chosen theme's name.

useWhen: Letting people choose a preset theme and a light or dark mode from one control
Rotating the theme at random while keeping manual choices one click away
avoidWhen: The page offers only light and dark; use ColorModePicker or ColorModeToggle
Appearance settings belong in a full settings page

accessibility: The icon button is named Theme and opens a dialog named Theme settings; Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.
The color mode and the themes are each one radio group with a single tab stop, so Tab crosses the popover in two stops.
The foot is a role=status element, so a new theme is announced, including the one Random picks.
unsupported: Saving the choice: it lives in React state and resets when the page reloads
Applying a saved or default theme before first paint: the page sets it on the document root, and the block selects that preset after mount
Restoring the colour scheme on unmount: ColorModePicker leaves its last scheme on the document
Seeing a preset's colours on a page that does not import themes.css
workflowValue: Replaces wiring a theme menu by hand: the popover, the colour mode, the theme grid, and the Random roll are one small component, so you replace the in-memory choice with your storage and keep the layout.
